one_liner.en: Crypto vs TradFi reads as “Risk-On Sync”: BTC +42.6%, trend Strong Uptrend, leverage Liquidation-Driven Squeeze; realized vol High Realized Vol, options vs RV IV Fair (vs RV); spot ETF channel “strong inflow” (BTC week net +6.36B).

compare.zh: 本季加密 BTC +42.6%，美股 ES +5.4% / NQ +0.3%，黄金 -1.4%。联动标签：同向 risk-on。现货 ETF 通道 BTC 周净流 +63.60 亿美金（强流入），与杠杆结构分开读。若全球风险偏好一致，常看到股和币同向；若相反，主引擎更可能在加密内部（杠杆、清算、情绪、现货通道），传统市场只提供背景板。
compare.en: Crypto BTC +42.6%; US equities ES +5.4% / NQ +0.3%; gold -1.4%. Link label: Risk-On Sync. Spot ETF channel BTC week net +6.36B (strong inflow); read apart from perp leverage. Global risk-on often moves stocks and crypto together; when they diverge, the main engine is more often inside crypto (leverage, liquidations, sentiment, spot ETF pipe), with TradFi as backdrop.

path.zh: 本季比特币从上一季的负收益翻成强势收涨约42.6%，以太坊更强约+70.9%。节奏不是一条直线：季内8月左右出现过明显加速上攻，随后9月更多在高位来回，但仍录得正收益。整体属于风险偏好回暖下的趋势上行，而非窄幅磨蹭。对照上季的回撤，本季斜率与幅度都明显抬升。
path.en: This quarter Bitcoin flipped from the prior quarter’s negative return into a strong finish near +42.6%; Ethereum ran harder at about +70.9%. The path was not a straight line: around August inside the quarter there was a clear acceleration higher, then September spent more time chopping at elevated levels while still ending positive. Overall it reads as trend-up inside a risk-on tone, not tight range grind. Versus the prior quarter’s pullback, both slope and magnitude stepped up.

leverage.zh: 杠杆画像偏「上涨段挤压」：季末资金费率折年约+8.77%，不算极端拥挤，但持仓量本季回落约12.1%。清算笔数峰值出现在季内8月21日前后（约3379笔量级），与价格加速段重合，像空头或高杠杆仓位被挤压后的痕迹。永续成交额本季合计约9244亿美金，现货约1031亿美金，活跃度正常偏热闹，但持仓下降说明部分杠杆在上涨中被消化或主动降仓。不把清算方向焊死成单边故事，只观察：趋势上行时杠杆并未简单堆积，反而伴随回落与脉冲式清算。
leverage.en: Leverage read as upside-squeeze traces: end-of-quarter funding annualized near +8.77%—not extreme crowding—while open interest fell about 12.1% over the quarter. Liquidation count peaked around 21 Aug inside the quarter (order of ~3379), lining up with the price acceleration stretch, consistent with shorts or high-leverage books getting squeezed. Perp turnover summed about $924.4B and spot about $103.1B—normal-to-lively activity—yet the OI drop shows leverage was digested or cut into the rise rather than simply stacking. We do not lock liquidation side into a one-way story; the observation is that the uptrend came with OI decline and pulse liquidations, not unchecked build.

etf.zh: 本季美现货比特币ETF通道呈强流入：合计净流入约+63.60亿美金，流入日42天、流出日22天；单日最大净流入约9.99亿（季内9月21日量级），也出现过约4.5亿量级的单日净流出。以太坊现货ETF同期净流入约+30.50亿美金。与上季净流出形成鲜明对照。只并陈通道松紧与价格同季上行，不把流入写成涨价的唯一原因。
etf.en: This quarter the US spot Bitcoin ETF channel showed strong inflow: net about +6.36B, with 42 inflow days and 22 outflow days; max single-day net near $999M (around 21 Sep inside the quarter) and a notable outflow day near $450M. Spot ETH ETFs added roughly +3.05B net over the same window. That contrasts sharply with the prior quarter’s net outflow. We place channel tone beside the same-quarter price advance—no welded claim that flows alone caused the move.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本季 1031.27 亿美金，相对上完整周 -5.8%（活跃度「中性」；上季约 1094.80 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-08-21（34.02 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 9243.97 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this quarter 103.13B, vs prior full week -5.8% (activity “normal”; prior ~109.48B). Peak day 2026-08-21 (3.40B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (924.40B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 先分清两个「波动」：RV（已实现/历史波动）是后视镜——价格已经抖得有多厉害；IV（隐含波动率）是保险报价——期权市场觉得未来会抖多厉害。RV 偏高 = 刚走过的路很颠；RV 偏低 = 最近相对平静。IV 偏高 = 保险贵，市场愿为未来不确定性付更高价；IV 偏低 = 保险便宜。IV 持续抬升 = 保费在变贵；IV 回落 = 紧张定价在缓解。RV 抬头 = 实现波动在升温；RV 回落 = 颠簸在缓和。二者同向升温 = 又颠又贵；同向降温 = 整体变稳。IV 升而 RV 不高 = 预期/谨慎溢价可能先行；RV 高而 IV 降 = 实现仍猛但保费在退或滞后。核心看 IV−RV：保险相对「刚实现的颠簸」贵了还是便宜了。以下只描述环境，不是买卖建议。
vol_teach.en: Two vols, not one: RV (realized) is the rear-view mirror—how rough price already was; IV (implied) is the insurance quote—how rough the options market prices the future. High RV = the road just traveled was bumpy; low RV = recent calm. High IV = expensive insurance; low IV = cheap insurance. Rising IV = insurance getting dearer; falling IV = stress premium easing. Rising RV = realized heat building; falling RV = bumps cooling. Both up = rough and expensive; both down = regime cooling. IV up / RV not extreme = caution or event premium may lead; RV hot / IV down = realized still fierce but insurance lagging or fading. Key gauge: IV−RV—rich or cheap insurance vs just-realized moves. Environment only—not trade advice.

vol_week.en: This quarter BTC: RV (rear-view) ~38.1% ann.; IV (Deribit insurance) end ~35.2%; from baseline 44.5% fell clearly (-9.3 pct pts). ETH: IV 49.4% / RV 52.6%.

vol_combo.en: IV−RV ≈ -2.9 pct pts: roughly fair vs realized.

vol_price_iv.en: Price up + IV down: insurance often cheapens in a tailwind (mechanism, not a forecast).

three_conclusions.zh: 本季主线是「回撤后的强势风险偏好修复」：BTC约+42.6%、ETH约+70.9%，与上季明显负收益对照，趋势上行且季内完成加速到高位震荡的切换。
three_conclusions.en: The quarter’s core story is a strong risk-on repair after the prior quarter’s pullback: BTC ~+42.6%, ETH ~+70.9%, a clear flip from prior negative returns, with trend-up that shifted from acceleration into elevated chop inside the quarter.

three_conclusions.zh: 杠杆与波动并陈：上涨中出现清算峰值与持仓回落约12%，资金费率温和正值；实现波动偏高而IV大致贴合，说明行情有热度但并非无杠杆单向堆出来的平静牛。
three_conclusions.en: Leverage and vol side by side: upside came with a liquidation peak and OI down ~12%, funding only mildly positive; realized vol elevated while IV roughly matched—heat without a calm, pure-leverage grind higher.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货ETF通道本季强流入（BTC约+63.60亿、ETH约+30.50亿），与价格同季上行并陈；传统资产同向但弱得多，加密弹性显著更大。下季关键在于流入与趋势、波动是否续上。
three_conclusions.en: Spot ETF channel strong inflow this quarter (BTC ~+6.36B, ETH ~+3.05B) sits beside the same-quarter advance; TradFi aligned but far weaker, crypto elasticity much larger. Next quarter hinges on whether flows, trend, and vol regime continue together.
